title: A geological engineer who thinks in systems.
paragraphs: I work at the intersection of geology, engineering, data, and technology, with a growing focus on understanding how they come together to solve real-world problems.

My academic and field experience spans geotechnical engineering, engineering geological investigations, exploration geophysics and geochemistry, hydrogeology, and field-based geological studies. Across these areas, I focus on turning observations and data into insights that can support better engineering decisions.

I also work at the intersection of geology and data analytics, using tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, GIS, and other technical software to analyse information, improve workflows, and communicate findings effectively. Professionally I value curiosity, precision, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving. I believe a good engineer should not only understand the technical problem but also understand the systems around it and look for better ways to solve it.
